messages.text:
Your cookware set is marked as shipped, but not yet delivered, so it isn’t eligible for a refund through this process yet (refund-policy/v1/eligible-orders).

The shop must also receive the item back before it can be refunded (refund-policy/v1/return).
What can I do to return it and get a refund once it arrives?

messages.text:
Once it arrives, you can arrange to return it. I don’t have the return address or label instructions available here, so I can’t provide those details.

To get a refund:
- The shop must receive the cookware set back and record the return (refund-policy/v1/return).
- Request the refund within 30 days of the recorded delivery time (refund-policy/v1/window).

Once the return is recorded, come back here and I can check eligibility and create a refund proposal.
